name: client-cowork-setup
description: Sets a client team up on Claude Cowork, then builds their knowledge base. Day one reads the person's real folder and does one live task first; each piece of setup repairs a miss they just watched. Voice mined from real writing, the first task made a tested skill with /twin, /end closing every session, /audit and /mot keeping it improving. Then /ember-setup makes the folder a governed knowledge base in Obsidian, refreshed weekly, client material anonymised before it goes public. Drafts only.
